new_defect_types.name: slogan_stuffing
new_defect_types.description: Unrequested invented corporate/motivational slogans scattered on walls, boxes, clothing and monitors to make a scene look 'designed'.
examples: phi287/gpt_image_2p5_sunburst: six slogans incl. 'LOGISTICS FOR A BRIGHTER TOMORROW' on a worker's shirt
phi287/gpt_image_2p5_sunburst_quality_high: 'SAME DAY A BRIGHTER TOMORROW', 'PACK SHIP REPEAT'
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: B07 lists template set dressing (brick walls, plants, bystanders) but not text; A03 only checks legibility, and these slogans are perfectly spelled.

new_defect_types.name: ego_viewpoint_misplacement
new_defect_types.description: The implied camera/vehicle sits in a physically or legally wrong place (dashcam straddling the double-yellow centreline).
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: All criteria judge visible objects; nothing covers where the viewer/camera itself is. Closest is A19.

new_defect_types.name: flow_from_empty_source
new_defect_types.description: A stream (sand, liquid, molten metal) flows out of a container that is visibly empty.
examples: orig45/gpt_image_2p5_sunburst: sand thread from an empty upper bulb
phi528/flux3_klein: molten stream from a dark empty crucible
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: Fits A12 but no example; VLMs rarely check source-sink consistency.

new_defect_types.name: unanchored_wing/appendage
new_defect_types.description: Fantasy appendages (wings) float beside a figure with no attachment point to the body.
examples: orig169/ideogram4_nf4: one wing hangs beside her shoulder while she faces camera
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A05 is about limbs; wings/tails on fantasy characters not mentioned, A09 is about objects.

rubric_issues.problem: Prompts that specify states or negations ('upper bulb empty', 'containing no sand at all', 'not flapping') have no clear code; I used B05 but it's neither attribute nor action.
examples: orig45/krea2_turbo: sand in both bulbs of the hourglass that must be empty
orig45/qwen_image_2p1_pe: sand at bottom of the 'no sand' hourglass
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Add B09 state_negation: object state, fill level, on/off, explicit 'no X' about a requested object. Severity major when the negation is the point of the prompt.

rubric_issues.problem: Character-share scoring does not penalise correct words in wrong order or a sentence split across pages out of sequence.
examples: orig524/flux3_klein: 'Knowledge always / to a brighter future.' + 'illuminates the path to'
orig524/qwen_image_2p1_pe: 'the path to' duplicated across lines
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: State that word-order errors and repeated phrases each count as wrong words; text must read correctly in natural reading order.

rubric_issues.problem: Left/right of character vs viewer is not defined; many models point with the wrong hand.
examples: orig524/flux3_klein and flux3_klein_base point with the character's left hand
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Add: 'left/right in a prompt refers to the character's own side unless the prompt says viewer's'; wrong hand = moderate.

rubric_issues.problem: Small sparkle logo marks in starry/fantasy scenes are easily read as scene sparkles.
examples: orig169/ideogram4_nf4: grey 4-point sparkle in bottom-right corner
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Add: a flat, unlit glyph in a corner that ignores scene lighting/perspective is a watermark.

rubric_issues.problem: Focal illustration cut by its own container inside a UI is neither frame crop nor obviously A18.
examples: orig400/flux3_klein_base: Notre Dame drawing cut off at portal level inside the glass card
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: A18: 'an element clipped by its container or overlapped by another UI element'.

rubric_issues.problem: Rack/rows with overlapping rims make counts hard; doubled rims (fibo) are A07 vs extra tubes (qwen nope) B01.
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Add example: a second rim/ghost outline on the same item is A07; a complete extra item is B01 (already in boundary rule, add a glassware example).

false_positive_traps.description: Glowing exterior of a crucible just out of a furnace is physically correct, not a lighting error.

Unrequested logo title text ('READING COACH', 'GUIDING THE WAY TO SUCCESS') on a logo prompt serves the design; flag only if it displaces requested text (B04 'prompt words written as unrequested text' may over-flag).
Second blurred Notre Dame / Eiffel tower in the bokeh background of a Paris app is scene-appropriate, not A07.
Motion blur of road foreground in a moving dashcam shot is motivated, not A21.
Rear-view mirror at the top of a dashcam frame is plausible camera placement.
Blank UI buttons are acceptable when the prompt only says 'function buttons'; don't flag A02/B04.
